name: Auto Complete Form Status Based on Required Fields
description: This external module will set the Form Status 'Complete?' dropdown automatically to 'Complete' when all required fields are entered, and set to 'Incomplete' when not all required fields are entered.

project-settings.name: Unverified status: Mark as Unverified if the field has not been Verified or Closed via the Data Resolution Workflow
What do you want to do with the Form Status 'Complete' field? If not set, it will be hidden by default

Apply to the following instruments/forms, with optional custom logic. Add one entry per group of instruments, or check the 'default' box in an entry to apply it to all instruments without their own entry. If no entries are added at all, the module applies to all instruments using the required fields check only

sub_settings.name: Use this entry as the default for all instruments that do not have their own entry
Custom logic (optional): REDCap logic that must evaluate to TRUE for the form to be marked Complete, e.g. [age] > 18 and [consent(1)] = '1'. Leave blank to use the required fields check only
How should this custom logic be combined with the default 'all required fields entered' check? If not selected, AND is used by default

choices.name: AND - all required fields must be entered AND the custom logic must be true (default)
OR - either all required fields entered OR the custom logic is true
NONE - just use the custom logic (ignore the required fields check)
